Same URL as Status; NOT a dead link. The article states the branch's initial-phase design capacity as '25亿方/年' (with an ultimate post-compression capacity of 71亿方/年) -- in Chinese convention 25亿 立方米 = 2.5 billion m3 = 2.5 bcm, exactly matching the recorded GEM value 'Capacity=2.50, CapacityUnits=bcm/y'. The automated DEAD_LINK/verifier fail was a literal-substring miss: it searched for '2.5' but the source text reads '25亿方' (25-with-亿-suffix, not '2.5亿'), a unit-magnitude quirk of Chinese numbering, not a value mismatch -- re-verified url_verifier with the correct token ('25亿方') and it passes (200, token present). Same corroboration-search effort as the Status unit; no independent second source found for the specific 2.50 bcm/y figure (the 2019-12 sasac.gov.cn construction-start article gives a different, non-comparable interim metric -- '新增供气能力3000万立方米/天', an aggregate corridor benefit statement, not this segment's design capacity -- so I did not cite it here to avoid implying it corroborates the specific bcm/y value). Tier held at medium.
